 The **scoped hunting rifle** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuclear Winter* update.

## Gameplay[edit]

A powerful rifle in a specific configuration found exclusively in the Nuclear Winter mode. Compared to the Adventure mode variant, the scoped hunting rifle has increased fire rate and accuracy with greatly increased damage and range, but suffers from drastically reduced ammo capacity.

## Locations[edit]

The specific scoped hunting rifle variant is only found in the Nuclear Winter battle royale mode. Being an uncommon item, they may be found inside Small Supply Crates alongside .308 Rounds.

- The name of the scoped hunting rifle found in Nuclear Winter isn't affected by standard modification prefixes.
- The scoped hunting rifle uses modifications with the same names as those in Adventure mode but are separate entities created specifically for the Nuclear Winter game mode.
